verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a public Developer API with a getting-started flow (create an app under Company → Developer, mint a token, call the Transactions API). It uses OAuth 2.0 client-credentials and authorization-code grants with granular resource:permission scopes, and publishes a canonical OpenAPI schema plus a plain-text endpoint reference. Write endpoints are documented (POST /bills, Vault card creation, Custom Records, AI-usage ingest), along with a sandbox API base for safe testing; a probe confirmed the machine-readable docs index is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API calls succeeding beyond vendor docs and the docs-index probe.
